reader.requirement: At --std 85 ALL literal represents the literal's characters repeated (and truncated) to the associated item's size, before and independent of JUSTIFIED (GRL2.1), or the literal's own length when unassociated (GRL2.3); the literal must be a nonnumeric literal (a numeric literal after ALL is refused) and must not itself be a figurative constant; 1985's only nonnumeric literal is the quotation-mark form, so ALL X".." / ALL N".." are refused; a multi-character ALL literal associated with a numeric or numeric-edited item is legal (obsolete) at 85.

edition-consulted.switches: ALL X".." / ALL N".." / ALL B".." literal forms refused at 85 (COBOL0900), admitted at 2023
Constructs.AllLiteralMulticharNumericRemoved2002: a multi-character ALL literal moved to a numeric item is admitted at 85 and refused (COBOL0902) from 2002
Constructs.MoveAllDigitIntegerObsolete2023: digit-only ALL literal to an integer item silent at 85, COBOL0903 warning at 2023
takes the EditionContext for reporting the literal-1 rules; no edition branch on a plain quoted literal

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the multi-character ALL literal associated with a numeric item is legal at 85 and removed from 2002; the hexadecimal/national/boolean ALL forms exist only from 2002

reader.notes: The grammar admits only a nonnumeric literal kind after ALL (allLiteral), so numeric literals are syntax errors; BoundAllLiteral carries the repeat-to-size semantics. STRING ALL "AB" is refused with COBOL1757, which §1985:VI.6.25.3 SR1 requires. The ALL ALL "A" refusal's message ('expected &') names the concatenation operator, a 2002 construct, a wording matter only.

refuter.evidence: Attack on the 85-only obsolete arm beyond MOVE (the reader probed MOVE only): src/al_cmp.cob at 85 -> exit 0: IF N4(1212) = ALL "12" EQ and ALL "1" = N4 NE (comparison of a numeric integer with a multi-character ALL literal admitted at 85, numeric moved to alphanumeric of its size); VALUE ALL "12" on ZZZ9 -> [1212] (VALUE on a numeric-edited item, admitted and unedited); VALUE ALL "AB" on XBXB [ABAB]; X(7) VALUE ALL "ABC" [ABCABCA]; MOVE ALL "XY" to a group with a COMP child -> G1 [XY]; X7(2:3) = ALL "BC" NE ('BCA' vs 'BCB', sized to the reference-modified operand). cite.py: OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 GR6 'The literal must be a nonnumeric literal'; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 (SRL3.2) 'is an obsolete feature in Standard COBOL'; OK §1985:VI.5.15.4.
